item.title: Russia and Ukraine exchange overnight attacks, leaving multiple dead
item.description: Drones and missiles kills three people, including a four-year-old in Ukraine as Russia suffers destruction of different facilities

item.title: Call of Duty co-creator dies in car crash
item.description: The 55-year-old was killed while driving his Ferrari on a road north of Los Angeles

item.title: HSBC Malta employees to get €30 million in compensation after CrediaBank sale
item.description: HSBC Malta will contribute €10 million toward employee compensation, while the remaining €20 million will be funded by its parent company

item.title: Labour Party, State Advocate to appear as co-defendants in voter database leak case
item.description: The case dates back to 2020, when it was revealed that a database containing 337,384 records of Maltese voters’ personal information was freely accessible online for at least a year after it was left exposed by C-Planet (IT Solutions)

item.title: MIDI says it turned to Portelli for Fort Tigne sale after long discussions with government
item.description: In its statement, MIDI clarified that, 'Prior to initiating a search for private investors, MIDI had exhausted discussions with government and Heritage Malta for the return of Fort Tigne to government'

item.title: Motorcyclist suffers grievous injuries in Fgura crash
item.description: A 70-year-old motorcyclist was injured in a crash on Vjal Kottoner in Fgura

item.title: Puttinu’s new €25 million therapy centre to be financed by citizenship donations
item.description: Prime Minister Robert Abela announces that foreigners seeking Maltese citizenship by merit will be favourably considered if they make a ‘significant and substantial’ donation to a new therapy centre in Mosta being built by Puttinu Cares

item.title: 457 patients received HIV prevention medication
item.description: ​The GU Clinic issued prescriptions for medication that helps prevent HIV infection to 457 patients in 2025, Health Minister Jo Etienne Abela told parliament

item.title: Hotel and apartment blocks proposed in St Julian’s village core
item.description: A boutique hotel and two apartment blocks are being proposed on a large site in the historic heart of St Julian’s, raising questions about how the development would fit within the traditional streetscape
